reason: Three locked test files that are not in the spec's §5 re-pin table (and not in its 'checked and expected unchanged' list) fail. They pin seeded-play examples, and the new re-raise-not-mine grids change TAG's preflop folds, which shifts those examples. The change is unavoidable for any edit to these spots: the same tests were re-pinned by TASK-7.32 and TASK-7.8 for the same reason. They are locked, so the builder cannot edit them. Also the scope budget (files=22) is exceeded: the spec missed the files below, plus src/bots/tag.ts (see evidence) and 3 unlocked tests re-pinned for the same shift.
evidence: On base e8005a62 all 7 affected files pass (36/36). With the change, npm test fails 6 tests in 3 files, and 1557 pass. (1) tests/bots/calling-station.acceptance.test.ts (owner TASK-6.3), 'facing a bet where the advice is fold…': :204 Example B fold[35] is now preflop, not the 5c3c flop view, because new not-my-raise folds are inserted earlier in the seed-61 fold list. Index, replay code, seed and draw all need re-deriving. (2) tests/bots/maniac.acceptance.test.ts (owners TASK-6.4, TASK-6.25), 4 tests: :233 Example A check[0] is now 'turn', not 'flop'; :294 Example B call[1] is now 'flop', not 'preflop'; :429 capped Example G gives fold, not call 16; :439 the worker test uses call[1] with seed 1461725007. All are index/seed pins over the seed-61 TAG-vs-random run. (3) tests/playtest/games.acceptance.test.ts (owner TASK-1.16), AC#7 cash 1,000 hands seed 42: :200 sidePots is now 0, so expect(sidePots).toBeGreaterThan(0) fails. Rebuys and all-ins still pass. In the same way, the unlocked tests/bots/calling-station-draws.acceptance.test.ts (fold[0]/fold[30] → fold[1]/fold[33], same views) and tests/playtest/cli.test.ts (first Mixed replacement at hand 42, was 18) were re-pinned by the builder. The A-4 claim 'no compile need' was wrong: src/bots/tag.ts:81 mixedSpots.get(`preflop-${situation}`) is keyed by SpotType, so typecheck failed. Fixed with `as SpotType`, as src/playtest/style-check.ts:119 does, with no behaviour change. Everything else is done: lint and typecheck are clean, the AC#8 slow run is healthy before and after (table in changes.md), and every listed re-pin is made.
options: Recommended: unlock the three files under their owners for re-pin edits only. calling-station.acceptance (TASK-6.3): re-derive Example B, and Example C if it shifts, by locating the same views (flop 5c3c facing 4; CO 97o) in the new fold list and updating index, code, seed and nextUint32 pins, with a 'before TASK-7.40' note. maniac.acceptance (TASK-6.4/6.25): the same for Examples A, B, C, E, G, H and the worker test's call[1]/seed. games.acceptance (TASK-1.16): keep all three > 0 checks, and pick the smallest hands count or seed that has a side pot again, stated in a comment.
